# authwise_asset (Resource)

A static asset the hosted pages serve, such as a logo. This is the asset's metadata; upload the file itself with `authwise_asset_content`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `display_name` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `mime_type` (String)
- `path` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `asset_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `name` (String) Full resource name; serves as the Terraform ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by full resource name.
terraform import authwise_asset.example tenants/t-01/assets/as-01
```
